passages.title: Procedure Text: Upcycling Materials
passages.text: Make a pencil holder from an empty glass jar. You need one clean jar, a soft cloth, coloured paper, and glue. First, wash the jar and check that it has no sharp edges. Next, dry its outer surface with the cloth. Then attach the paper with a small amount of glue. Leave the holder to dry before placing pencils inside. If the glass is chipped, choose another container instead. The goal is to reuse a safe object rather than throw it away.
